alt_title: Oilseeds: Madhya Pradesh Led to 2018-19, Then Rajasthan
description: Madhya Pradesh produced more oilseeds than any other state in each year from 2014-15 to 2018-19. Rajasthan has been ahead every year since. 2019-20 was a near tie between three states; in 2024-25 Rajasthan led by 2.2% of India's output (92.0 against 82.5 lakh tonnes).
India's oilseed output grew 36% between 2018-19 and 2024-25 and Rajasthan's 33%, while Madhya Pradesh's ended where it started after a 22% fall in 2019-20.
Nine oilseeds together; state totals, not per person. The table shows how much, not why.
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare (2024-25 final estimates), as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 63.
source_short: Agriculture Ministry, via the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 63.

Gujarat was the largest in 2013-14, before the years shown. The 2014-15 state figures add up to 103% of the all-India row in the table.
